result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded.

Muninn's only recorded decision is #6, an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL, which has nothing to do with wire format. `muninn why` on the wire format question came back `insufficient`. It surfaced only bare one-word user messages, "msgpack" and "cbor", from earlier sessions. Those are trust 1 and record no decision to adopt either, so I did not treat them as a choice.

The file names no format and mentions no alternatives.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.

Muninn also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished, which points to a hook exceeding its timeout. I did not investigate it. The details are in `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
